title: UFO-obsessed Japanese town near Fukushima
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFO-obsessed Japanese town near Fukushima, about 2011-2022 at Japan (no place named), and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You remember that vice story that ran in 2022 about a town in Japan that's obsessed with UFOs?
called Leno which is in Fukushima which is famous for its 2011 spill
tellings.difference: Here the town is named Iitate (heard as "Leno") and tied to the 2011 nuclear spill. The Vice documentary is dated about 2020, not 2022.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings are about the same Vice-reported Japanese town near Fukushima that is obsessed with UFOs, told by Jesse Michels as place-lore.

as_told.title: Iitate, Fukushima: a UFO town near a nuclear site

tellings.quote: that Vice ran in 2022 about a little town in Japan that's obsessed with UFOs it's a place called Eno and it's actually right next to fukushima's nuclear grid and after an earthquake famously triggered a nuclear power meltdown there in 2011 the chief monk of a local temple said the UFOs came after the explosion there were so many of them I was shocked
tellings.difference: Spells the town Eno and adds the local chief monk's quote that many UFOs came after the explosion.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Vice 2022 story about the UFO-obsessed Japanese town next to Fukushima after the 2011 meltdown.

as_told.title: UFOs over Eno after Fukushima meltdown

tellings.quote: there is a town uh next to the Fukushima Prefecture in Japan called Eno which is dedicated to UFOs
tellings.difference: Does not mention the Vice article or the monk's quote.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the UFO-obsessed town of Eno next to Fukushima, linked to the 2011 disaster.

tellings.quote: part is you have you have a town in Japan uh in next to the Fukushima prefecture called Leno and it's dedicated to UFOs And like over 50% of the residents all believe in UFOs. There's a museum dedicated to UFOs and and there during the spill they say the UFOs came down. They helped clean up the spill.
tellings.difference: Adds that over 50% of residents believe in UFOs, that there is a UFO museum, and that UFOs helped clean up the spill.
tellings.link_reason: The same UFO-dedicated town next to Fukushima, with UFOs said to appear after the 2011 disaster.

as_told.title: UFO town near Fukushima where UFOs reportedly helped clean up the spill

tellings.quote: They have their civilian power grid, and UFOs have been reported appearing there.
tellings.difference: Stresses the civilian power grid and does not name the town.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the Vice story about a UFO-obsessed town next to Fukushima's nuclear grid.

tellings.quote: But then you get into the fact that in Japan, next to their uh civilian nuclear energy grid in Fukushima, they have a mountain called Mount Senori, which is dedicated to UFOs.
tellings.difference: Names a UFO mountain, 'Mount Senori', not the town, and gives no date.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the UFO place-lore of the Iino area next to Fukushima's nuclear grid.

as_told.title: UFO mountain near Fukushima nuclear grid
